Priya: Heads-up: quickstart sample spiked 429s during load test. Repro shows refresh churn plus pagination storms.
Ken: Paging + concurrent clients = lots of parallel requests. Are refreshes racing too?
Priya: Yes. Token refresh path bypasses the client-side window so when many cursors hit token expiry we get a flood.
Renee: JS SDK uses per-connection limiter; Go uses shared. Might be parity gap.
Ken: Proposed short-term: serialize refreshes (small queue) and add random backoff on retry.
Priya: Also cap concurrent pagination calls per connection to prevent runaway tail. Default to 4.
Renee: I'll add a shared adapter limiter and a flag `serializeRefresh=true` for quickstart.
sdk-bot: [CI] test/refresh-serialize started (job #1221).
Priya: Telemetry: sample 429s during surge (sample_rate=0.1) to avoid alert flood, but emit full traces for distinct error codes.
ops-bot: Deployed quickstart change to canary. Monitor dashboards for spike regression.
Ken: Long-term idea: server sends `x-client-rate-hint` header so SDKs adapt windows dynamically. Open doc?
Renee: Yes. I'll draft parity PR and migration notes.
Priya: Thanks — will watch canary and follow up with any adjustments. :thumbsup:
